name: Return of Zero · Room 6 of 8 · §4 — Psychoid Flowering
description: The mathematical substrate becomes psychologically consequential when the opposed terms are psyche and matter, subject and signifier, conscious and unconscious, form and participation. Six movements as addressable scenes in one shared section-room grammar. Binds to section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/ at Antykathera-Essay-Work dbf3b17.

text.title: Two descriptions retained across one seam
text.body: A pattern appearing on both sides of an unmastered threshold.

text.title: Determining capacity and indefinite particular in one relation
text.body: The instance brightens; the capacity grows to meet it.

text.title: The complexio oppositorum preserves the energy of opposites
text.body: Four held apart, two kept implicit, one centre turning.

text.title: The stroke that first hides zero becomes the bar
text.body: The crossed zero unfolds as a psychoid sequence.

text.title: Apollonian form becomes transparent to Dionysian participation
text.body: Form fades, participation swells, and each returns.

text.title: Each account a declared refraction
text.body: One light through many lenses, each declared.
